standard_prerequisites.name: Ramification indices are multiplicative in towers of discrete valuation rings
standard_prerequisites.use: Combines the tamely ramified indices along the tower.

core_obligations: Let C be the integral closure of A in M; every maximal ideal m' of C contracts to a maximal ideal m of B (proof lines 34149-34151). At m' the ramification index over A is the product of the ramification indices of C_m over B_m and B_m over A, which is prime to the residual characteristic by the tameness hypotheses and the multiplicative-e-f lemma (proof lines 34152-34153). The residue field extension kappa(m')/kappa_A factors as the tower kappa(m')/kappa(m)/kappa_A of finite separable extensions, each tame by hypothesis, so M/K is tamely ramified with respect to A (proof lines 34154-34156).
proof_roadmap: Relate the primes of C to those of B (proof lines 34149-34151).
Multiply ramification indices and compose the residue field tower (proof lines 34152-34156).
difficulty_reason: 10 行、平凡分歧扩张的复合：C 的每个极大理想 m' 收缩到 B 的极大理想 m；m' 处分歧指数 = e(C_m/B_m)·e(B_m/A)，两因子都与剩余特征互素（multiplicative-e-f 引理）；剩余域塔 κ(m')/κ(m)/κ_A 各步由假设平凡（tame），故 M/K 对 A 平凡分歧。承重全在 span 内；1 处引用作导航桩。
